title: om: notebook block
description: The `om:` block in the YAML front matter of a workflow notebook (oceanmetrics/workflows). One block per notebook names the target, its dependencies and the manifest it writes; the run order, the DAG and the index page are generated from the blocks (om-extract notebooks index). Modelled on the calcofi: and msens: blocks of the CalCOFI and MarineSensitivity workflows.

target_name.description: the target id, unique across the repo; snake_case; by convention the notebook's file name without .qmd

workflow_type.description: what the notebook does; the index groups by it

dependency.description: target_names this notebook reads from; they run first. Empty or absent for a root.

output.description: the manifest the notebook writes when it finishes (relative to the repo root, or an s3:// or https:// URL); its existence is the target's done marker

products.description: the files or catalogs the notebook publishes, for the index page

schedule.description: when the notebook is meant to run: a five-field cron expression, or manual

status.description: active notebooks run and are listed first; archived ones are kept for the record and never run; draft ones are listed but not scheduled

description.description: one sentence for the index card
